ideas.pitch: A lightweight automated patching daemon for attack-defense CTFs that detects anomalous system calls and applies binary patches in real-time.
ideas.problem_statement: DEFCON 2.0: Attack-Defense CTF - Defend systems, detect intrusions, patch weaknesses, and keep services secure.
ideas.title: AutoPatch CTF Daemon
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the defense component of a 4-hour Attack-Defense CTF where manual patching is too slow and automated defense-in-depth wins the leaderboard.

ideas.pitch: An orchestration tool designed specifically for fast-paced 4-hour CTFs to queue, fire, and track exploitation scripts across opponent targets.
ideas.problem_statement: DEFCON 2.0: Attack-Defense CTF - Find vulnerabilities, exploit systems, and complete objectives to score points.
ideas.title: RedTeam Payload Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the extreme time constraint of a 4-hour event by providing rapid execution and scoring tracking, giving teams a mechanical advantage in the attack phase.

ideas.pitch: A real-time network traffic sniffer and visualizer built for attack-defense CTFs to spot incoming reverse shells and unauthorized access instantly.
ideas.problem_statement: DEFCON 2.0: Attack-Defense CTF - Detect intrusions and keep your services secure.
ideas.title: CTF Traffic Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the real-time visualization pattern that won network security hackathons, making intrusion detection glanceable during chaotic live gameplay.

ideas.pitch: A rigid checker and watchdog daemon that monitors your team's flag-storing services and restarts them the millisecond an adversary drops a service.
ideas.problem_statement: DEFCON 2.0: Attack-Defense CTF - Balance offense and defense to stay ahead on the leaderboard.
ideas.title: Service Health Watchdog
ideas.why_it_could_win: In short CTFs, uptime is points. Ensuring flag services never drop due to crashing exploits keeps baseline SLA points high while attacking.

ideas.pitch: An automated pipeline that intercepts incoming captured flags, validates them, and safely submits them to the CTF scoring engine without leaking secrets.
ideas.problem_statement: DEFCON 2.0: Attack-Defense CTF - Outscore and fight for the top spot by capturing flags efficiently.
ideas.title: Flag Vaulting Pipeline
ideas.why_it_could_win: Automates the final scoring loop so players can focus entirely on offensive exploitation and defensive patching rather than manual flag entry.
